dedupe_keys.name: dataset asorption of thms by biochar produced from olive oil solid waste

description: The source describes experiments with biochars prepared by pyrolysis, chemical activation and physical activation to adsorb trihalomethanes from water. The dataset title identifies olive-oil solid waste as the starting material. A related presentation describes the same biochar preparation and water-treatment subject, without proving identical experimental samples. The inspected metadata do not specify sorption capacities, kinetic parameters, concentrations or the full set of tested biochars. The source authors provide these water-quality study data; geographic coverage is not stated. The source marks the data restricted while publishing CC BY 4.0 metadata. No access procedure, fee, availability date or permission to obtain the underlying files is established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Data values, archives, images and linked article or poster bodies remain unread. The reported treatment subject establishes the resource role, while measurement quality, independent sample counts and overlap with related experiments remain unverified.
